methods: Construct and independently check one source-bound instance of the stated first experiment.

original_card.acceptance_gate: Require a legal chronological rewrite and favorable complete signed target-minus-paid moment with all extra charges. Unchanged ADD counts or unchanged paid-call counts alone decide neither success nor failure. Compiler, native and outer admission remain separate obligations.

original_card.first_experiment: Construct one legal source-bound rewrite and compare complete before/after P and T. Charge restoration, source windows and owned helpers. A paid call need not disappear: a legal target split or rank redistribution may win. Stop if the signed moment is unchanged or the consumer repays the gain. Do not extend a scalar-only census on ADD counts.

actual_scope: Exact paid-side fusion ceiling in the signed moment model at a sub-unit crossing exponent: strict superadditivity, the sharp single-fusion cap min(a,b)^c, the total fusion budget G(c), and the resulting upper bound on the crossing exponent for any paid-only fusion scheme. No source-bound word, caller or invoice instance is evaluated.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a source-bound rewrite or a target-specific obstruction. This package takes the card's second method but at the model level: it bounds the whole paid-fusion mechanism with one scalar, before any word is chosen. The reduction is recorded here; a source-bound instance remains the open next question.
bottleneck_link: Paid-fusion families are a recurring search direction in the current P104 and BIT exclusion rounds. The ceiling decides a whole family with one root computation instead of one replay per member, and it shows that the sub-unit exponent is exactly what makes fusion profitable at all.
stop_rule: Stop after the sharp cap, the global budget and the crossing consequence are proved and exactly corroborated; do not extend to a source-bound invoice in this package.
